observation.command:
cd /tmp
TOKEN=$(curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"username":"admin","password":"AdminLocalPassw0rd!"}' https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/ | sed -n 's/.*"access":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
for ep in content-types address node trench cable microduct fiber projects logs wms-sources; do echo -n "$ep:"; curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} " "https://api.localhost/api/v1/$ep/"; done; echo
echo "=== mock cable? count ==="; curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.localhost/api/v1/node/" | head -c 200
